name: What is the advantage of hiring a general contractor versus managing separate trades?

mainEntity.name: What is the advantage of hiring a general contractor versus managing separate trades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor provides a single point of contact who oversees project flow, ensures structural integrity, and manages specialized sub-trades. While individual subcontractors focus strictly on single trades like plumbing or electrical, a hands-on general contractor directly manages carpentry, framing, drywall, and finish tile while sequencing trade partners smoothly. This approach eliminates communication gaps, scheduling conflicts, and finger-pointing between separate trades. It also ensures that finish work—like custom molding and seamless drywall repair—integrates properly with newly roughed-in systems, saving you time and preventing costly rework.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor serves as a single point of contact, coordinating framing, finishes, and specialized sub-trades to prevent scheduling delays and conflicting work.
